proposed_fields.Named use and action: `basis_fit_admission`; authorize whether one exact occurrence may influence ordinary-route detector centering and PCA basis/subspace estimation
proposed_fields.Authoritative source: Draft SCI-FRUIT-POINT-BOUNDARY-DRAFT@r0.1, SOURCE_ADOPTION_DRAFT.md, and exact inherited clause predicates below. Final adopted PTC source/profile digest unavailable; no executable permission exists from this draft.
proposed_fields.Applicability and object: Separately requested and source-admitted initial POINT reference, feedback pass k>=1 only; one immutable exact CAL-derived residual rho_k with B01/B02/B08 identities and the exact current PTC group/segment. Atomic sample-detector occurrence in its exact basis/centering fit population.
proposed_fields.Required restrictions: Exact CAL parent, detector/sample identity, group, segment, calibrated `x`, basis-fit support/mask, and every quantity explicitly used by the frozen basis estimator are resolved and numerically admissible. The occurrence lies within the exact group/segment, its required calibrated `x` is finite and available, and its basis-fit mask admits it. Direct ALIGN-synthesized or RTC-replaced origin is a decisive exclusion. No unrelated metadata is a restriction
proposed_fields.Centering consequence: Eligibility supplies binary centering influence one and basis influence. Ineligibility supplies binary centering influence zero. The same admitted finite population defines the frozen ordinary \(\lambda_{g,d}\); VAL does not infer a different centering estimator
proposed_fields.Classification consequence: CAL `engineering-only` is preserved and has no basis-fit admission consequence by itself; eligibility does not create CAL science qualification
proposed_fields.Exceptions: None. Direct synthesized/replaced origin and failed required numerical inputs are non-exceptionable under this profile
proposed_fields.Response/uncertainty roles: `advisory` for both. Their typed states remain visible, but numerical response or covariance availability is not required for basis fitting
proposed_fields.Aggregation and propagation compatibilit: `atomic_only`; no VAL aggregate or reverse propagation is defined. Consumption of eligible atomic occurrences by the exact PTC centering/basis estimator is the named action, not permission for another use
proposed_fields.Missing/conflicting behavior: Missing/conflicting structural binding or applicability authority yields `applicability_unknown` and `decision_unavailable`. For an applicable requested occurrence, any decisive false restriction yields `ineligible`, all restrictions true yields `eligible`, and every remaining required U/C state yields `decision_unavailable`; all facts and causes are preserved
proposed_fields.Action scope and nonimplication: Authorizes only centering and basis/subspace influence. It grants no loading-fit, operator-application, output-retention, coefficient/QC, response, empirical/simulation, exposure, or MAP permission
proposed_fields.Supersession: A changed domain, estimator population, centering identity, restriction, exception, common-fragment digest, or source digest requires a new immutable profile version; no prior decision is rewritten This candidate is an additional residual-domain version; ordinary @1 and its evaluated decisions remain available unchanged for the ordinary route, never aliases for @2.
proposed_fields.Inherited clause predicates: Frozen SCI-PTC clauses `SCI-PTC-DEF-007`, `SCI-PTC-REQ-012`, `SCI-PTC-REQ-016`, `SCI-PTC-REQ-023`, `SCI-PTC-REQ-031`, `SCI-PTC-REQ-090`--`SCI-PTC-REQ-094`, and `SCI-PTC-REQ-098`; `WP5-OWNER-D004` and `WP5-OWNER-D011`; exact common and source bindings above
proposed_fields.Additional required restrictions: Exact B01-B08 residual permission, method/iteration, CAL realization, applied model, projection/subtraction/rho generation, quantity/beam/reference, occurrence/coordinate/support and direct-origin/transitive-influence facts; exact source/profile and current decision generation. Ordinary @1 permission or an external-parent identifier cannot substitute. Only inputs required by this named use affect its decision.
proposed_fields.Lifecycle: Each evaluation binds the current immutable residual, requested/effective/resolved/applied/realized identities and exact owner-source/profile generation. It grants only this named use; other named uses require separate current decisions.
